therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: intramyocardial stem cell engraftment and paracrine signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: therapeutic angiogenesis and myocardial perfusion restoration
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with end-stage ischemic cardiomyopathy / coronary artery disease not amenable to revascularization
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety as measured by combined early and late adverse events at baseline (periprocedural up to 2 weeks) and 6 months

results.effect_size: No statistically significant difference in major adverse events between arms; atrial arrhythmia 2/10 stem cell vs 0/10 control; angina exacerbation 5/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control; NSTEMI 1/10 stem cell vs 0/10 control; intracardiac thrombus 1/10 stem cell vs 0/10 control; EMM-related VT 0/10 stem cell vs 2/10 control; EMM-related VF 0/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control; cerebrovascular event 0/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control
biomarker_changes: LVESV at 6 months: stem cell 85.9 ml vs control 94.7 ml (baseline: 93.2 vs 94.9)
LVEDV at 6 months: stem cell 127.2 ml vs control 131.3 ml (baseline: 138.3 vs 132.7)
EF (echo) at 6 months: stem cell 36.0% vs control 34.0% (baseline: 36.1% vs 32.1%)
EF (SPECT-gated) at 6 months: stem cell 40.4% vs control 42.2% (baseline: 38.0% vs 41.9%)
WMSI at 6 months: stem cell 1.90 vs control 2.06 (baseline: 1.91 vs 2.13)
MVO2 at 6 months: stem cell 17.7 ml/kg/min vs control 14.6 ml/kg/min (baseline: 15.5 vs 14.1)
Total Severity Score (stress) at 6 months: stem cell 785.9 vs control 1132 (baseline: 798.2 vs 1007.6)
Total Severity Score (rest) at 6 months: stem cell 594.6 vs control 828 (baseline: 542.8 vs 812.4)
Total Severity Score (reversible) at 6 months: stem cell 22.9 vs control 87.3 (baseline: 72.6 vs 46.5)
subgroup_findings: NYHA at 6 months: stem cell 2.3 vs control 2.1 (baseline: 2.5 vs 2.6)
CCS at 6 months: stem cell 2.0 vs control 2.0 (baseline: 2.5 vs 2.5)
Reversible perfusion defect (SPECT) improved more in stem cell arm (72.6 to 22.9) vs control (46.5 to 87.3)
safety_signals: Atrial arrhythmia occurred in 2/10 stem cell patients vs 0/10 control
Angina exacerbation in 5/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control
NSTEMI in 1/10 stem cell vs 0/10 control
Intracardiac thrombus in 1/10 stem cell vs 0/10 control
EMM-related VT in 0/10 stem cell vs 2/10 control
EMM-related VF in 0/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control
Cerebrovascular event in 0/10 stem cell vs 1/10 control
Overall safety profile considered acceptable for a Phase 1 trial

dose_info.schedule: Single procedure, intramyocardial injection under electromechanical guidance via Myostar catheter after NOGA mapping

adverse_events.term: non-ST elevation MI / acute non-ST elevation MI
ventricular tachycardia / ventricular arrhythmia (including ICD shocks)
new stenotic lesion in SVG to RCA

context.indication: Coronary artery disease / end-stage ischemic cardiomyopathy
